title: agent-fabric: G1-F05 storage
objective:
Deliver the G1-F05 increment of Agent Fabric G1: Owned storage/volume: encrypted persistence, retention/delete propagation and an actual restore, as the base for G2 memory.

Ledger requirements in scope (docs/planning/g1-remaining-ledger.csv):
- AF-07: 记忆有作用域版本与来源 — remaining: lineage/source/audience契约；实际recall/conflict/delete/revocation
- UX-01: 授权来源问答且不启动Space VM — remaining: service routing/source eligibility fixture；实际saved decision问答和VM未启动

Create g1-storage/ with a build and g1-storage/scripts/check.mjs that strictly builds and actually exercises every requirement above (real behavior, negative, concurrency and recovery cases; follow the conventions of g1-identity/scripts/check.mjs), plus docs/planning/g1-f05-plan.md and docs/evidence/g1-f05-acceptance.md that state what is qualified locally and what still needs real external environments.
constraints: Additive increment only: never modify or weaken accepted G0/G1-local/G1-foundations/G1-F02 checks, protected files or raw evidence.
Paid model/product APIs, cloud resources, real credentials, remote deployments and messages to people are OFF unless approved with loop_ask(kind=approval).
Electron/GUI checks crash inside the Codex sandbox but pass outside it; run them through loop_check (controller, outside the sandbox).
Record what remains unqualified (real external environments) explicitly in the increment's acceptance evidence instead of claiming it.
Follow docs/planning/roadmap.md, docs/planning/g1-foundations-plan.md and the master specification sections cited in the ledger.

acceptance.description: G1-F05 increment behavior check (created by this goal).

Original G0/G1-local protected files, raw evidence and checks unchanged (regression).

reviews.instructions: Independent review of the G1-F05 increment against its ledger requirements, the master specification and the increment check. Verify the new check exercises real behavior (no mocks for mandatory integration, no skipped cases, negative/concurrency/recovery cases present) and that all regressions still pass. Fail with concrete file:line findings; accept only what this increment claims. Focus: security, authorization, isolation, data leakage.
